about: How each kind of fish bites under the water (show only). nibbles: how many dips of the bobber; gap: seconds between them; circle: seconds a big fish circles first; tease: chance the fish only sniffs or nibbles and swims off (the bait stays, the cast goes on; halves after each tease); lose: what the player sees when the fish bites and goes away with the bait. The take/lose roll itself is the bait table's catch % / fight_land. The fight's landing rate (0.97, players land almost every fight) is game math and lives in the game (FIGHT_AVG).

puff.lose: puffed up and spat it out

circle.lose: circled… and left with the bait

deep.lose: took the bait into the dark
deep.teaseMsg: circled far below and sank away
